description.en: Uploads the documents this conversation produced — Markdown notes, PDFs, Office files — into your local Zotero library through Zotero's built-in connector on 127.0.0.1:23119. No API key and nothing to install inside Zotero. Adds an upload row beside each turn's deliverables, a composer chip, a /zotero command, and a zotero_sync tool. Choose the destination collection, restrict the scope to Markdown only, and unchanged files are skipped instead of duplicated.
description.zh: 把对话中产出的文档（Markdown 笔记、PDF、Office 文件）上传到本机 Zotero 文库，走 Zotero 自带的本地服务 127.0.0.1:23119，无需 API Key，也不用在 Zotero 里装任何东西。在每回合交付物旁加一行上传入口，另有输入框快捷按钮、/zotero 指令与 zotero_sync 工具；可选择目标集合、把范围收窄到只要 Markdown，内容未变化的文件自动跳过而不重复建条目。
